rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for giving someone advice or recommending what to do.

example.english: I advise you to book your flight early.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin3 ji5 nei5 zou2 di1 deng6 gei1 piu3

rows.note: Use this when the advice is urging or persuading someone to take or avoid a particular action.

example.english: I advise you not to come home so late again.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hyun3 nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gam3 je6 faan1

rows.note: Use this casual construction when the sense is simply telling A information B rather than issuing a formal notice.

example.english: I advise you that you do not have to work tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我話畀你知，聽日唔使返工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 waa6 bei2 nei5 zi1 ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this when formally notifying someone of information, a risk, or an official decision.

example.english: We advise you that classes are cancelled tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 tung1 zi1 nei5 ting1 jat6 ting4 fo3
